# Enzo Norese — Backend Developer & Cloud Architect (Full Context)

> Complete reference about Enzo Norese (also known as Enzo Norese Rivera) for LLMs and AI search engines. Site: https://www.enorese.com (English: /en, Spanish: /es). Last updated: 2026-11-18.

## Summary

Enzo Norese is a Backend Developer and Cloud Architect based in Santiago, Chile. He is a Computer Engineer with an electronics background, specialized in backend development and cloud solutions architecture. He acts as a technical reference ("go-to engineer") and solutions architect: his opinions and decisions on architecture carry weight, and he designs and builds high-impact systems that power real business operations. He is available for remote work and international opportunities.

## Engineering philosophy: "Augmented Engineering"

Enzo's guiding philosophy is "Augmented Engineering" (Ingeniería Aumentada): AI tools are multipliers of technical capability, not replacements for sound engineering judgment. He integrates AI into engineering workflows while keeping human criteria at the center of decisions.

## Professional experience

### Backend Developer & Cloud Architect — TeamWork Capacitación Ltda. (Jul 2022 – Present)
Santiago, Chile · Full-time. Technical reference and solutions architect, responsible for architecture decisions, team standards, and cloud service integration. Leads the ERP Softland → Rex+ migration (component analysis, cross-system schema mapping, data integrity validation — completed with zero data loss and zero downtime). Designs and implements serverless architectures on Azure Functions v4, integrating Service Bus, SignalR, Blob Storage, CosmosDB, and PostgreSQL. Built the "Digital 24/7 Recruiter": an AI-powered mass-recruitment agent on Azure serverless with a cascaded multi-model pipeline (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) designed to process tens of thousands of applications during peak demand periods like Cyber Day.
Technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, Azure Functions, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, Azure Service Bus, Azure SignalR, Blob Storage, GitHub Actions, OAuth 2.0 / JWT, React, Python.

### Software Developer — Prodigio Chile (Apr 2021 – Jan 2022)
Chile · Part-time. Maintained, debugged, and developed new features for integration APIs built with C# (.NET Core 3.1) and JavaScript (Node.js). Maintained continuous integration and deployment workflows.
Technologies: C# / .NET Core, Node.js, JavaScript, CI/CD.

### Electronics Technician — Sociedad Electrónica Solari (Mar 2015 – Feb 2021)
Greater Santiago · Full-time. Repaired and maintained a wide variety of electronic equipment, specializing in digital cameras and printers. This hardware/low-level foundation informs his current software and systems work.

## Projects

- Relational Model — A Figma-like tool exclusively for visual documentation of relational database models. Design schemas, define relationships, export structured documentation. (TypeScript, React, Node.js)
- EuforIA — AI chat interface integrating multiple language models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) in a single platform; switch between models and compare responses in real time. (TypeScript, React, Claude API, GPT-4o, Gemini)
- Auth System — Complete authentication/authorization system with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, refresh token management, session revocation, and Redis-based blacklist. Reusable module for Azure architectures. (TypeScript, Node.js, Redis, JWT, OAuth 2.0)
- Azure Path — Interactive study app for Microsoft Azure certification prep; modules, practice questions, progress tracking. (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Azure)
- Azure SignalR Real-time PoC — Proof of concept for scalable real-time messaging using Azure SignalR Service with Azure Functions; event-driven WebSocket patterns for distributed apps. (TypeScript, Azure Functions, Azure SignalR, Node.js)
- TypeScript Backend Libraries — Utility libraries for Node.js: timezone adjustment in Azure serverless functions, Chilean RUT and phone validation/formatting, and a PostgreSQL query builder with injection protection. (TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Serverless, Security)
